description:
Physical form of the buildings a set of UPRNs sit in: height, volume,
    footprint area, floor count, construction and roof material, basement,
    green roof, solar panels, and the residential/commercial unit mix.

    `year_built` and `num_floors` are thinly populated and come back null
    rather than estimated — treat null as unknown, not as absent.

    `footprint_geojson` is the recorded WGS84 building outline, simplified at
    0.5 m, for report maps and illustrative 3D massing. Use `building_height_m`
    (volume divided by footprint), never altitude `height_m_above_sea_level`,
    for extrusion. Preserve `geometry_attribution`. The extrusion does not
    show actual facades, roof details, or a flat's internal boundaries.

    UK only. Costs 15 credits (15p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: building_physical
title: Physical form of buildings
